proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10930.1 *latta gives Awan lattā “clothes”, Kumauni lattā and Hindi lattā “tattered cloth”. Rana latta fits the expressive defective/rag family; this does not assert an independently settled Sanskrit origin. Joint comparison: Sunha lʌtːa “cloth” matches reviewed Rana lʌtːa “cloth” (f_pkc5zm2mdc6cc). The shared family is provisionally linked under the user’s preference; inheritance versus intra-IA borrowing is not resolved by this formal comparison.
